otherSenses: strait (as in a waterway, e.g. Straße von Gibraltar)

examples: The *road* to the village is very narrow.
Many *roads* are closed because of the snow.
Die *Straße* zum Dorf ist sehr schmal.
Viele *Straßen* sind wegen des Schnees gesperrt.

variants.note: In Switzerland the word is written 'Strasse' (no ß); otherwise the same. The Swiss pronunciation has a typically more alveolar/trilled r.

de.note: Straße also means 'street' within a town; for a road between places, Landstraße (country road) or Weg (way, path) are common alternatives.

examples: La *route* du village est très étroite.
Beaucoup de *routes* sont fermées à cause de la neige.
fr.note: For a street within a town, French uses 'rue', whereas 'route' is used for roads between places.

examples: A *estrada* para o vilarejo é muito estreita.
Muitas *estradas* estão fechadas por causa da neve.
A *estrada* para a aldeia é muito estreita.
Muitas *estradas* estão fechadas por causa da neve.
variants.note: European Portuguese prefers 'aldeia' for a small village; 'vilarejo' is more Brazilian.

pt.note: For a street in a town, Portuguese uses 'rua'; 'estrada' is for roads between places.

sense: street, road in a town or village

examples: I live on a quiet *street* near the park.
The *streets* are very busy on Saturday.
Ich wohne in einer ruhigen *Straße* in der Nähe vom Park.
Am Samstag sind die *Straßen* sehr voll.

variants.note: Standard Swiss spelling uses ss instead of ß (Strasse); the app converts this automatically, so the word is otherwise the same.

examples: J'habite dans une *rue* calme près du parc.
Le samedi, les *rues* sont très animées.
fr.note: French distinguishes 'rue' (street in a town) from 'route' (road between places), whereas German 'Straße' covers both.

examples: Eu moro numa *rua* tranquila perto do parque.
Aos sábados, as *ruas* ficam muito movimentadas.

variants.note: European Portuguese pronunciation differs; the sentences are otherwise identical in structure, with a slightly different word for 'busy'.
examples: Aos sábados, as *ruas* estão muito movimentadas.

pt.note: Portuguese distinguishes 'rua' (town street) from 'estrada' (road between places).
